3. Plaintiff's case, in short, is that, suit land was originally belong to Raj Kumar Chandra who transferred 591/2 decimals of land from dag No 1688 by registered saf kabala dated 24-2-14 to Chandra Mohan and Jogendra Chandra. Raj Kumar on the same date by another registered saf kabala No. 1702 transferred 29 1/2 decimals of land from dag No. 1688 and 11 decimals of land from dag No. 1684, totaling 40/2 decimals of land to Brojo Mohan and become titleless inspite of that CS Khatian was prepared in his name. But SA khatian No. 548 was prepared in the name of Chandra Mohan, Jogendra Mohan and Brojo Mohan. The sons of Ram Dayal by registered deed No. 9571 dated 23-10-1948 sold their share to Horihor Chandra. The heirs of recorded tenant of CS and SA khatian were in possession and while they were in peaceful possession by power of attorney to plaintiff, Arman Ali Sarker exchange the entire land and by giving delivery of possession to Arman Ali Sarker, having title less, left the suit premises. Annan Ali Sarker having possession enjoyed the suit land for more than 12 years, died leaving only son, Munnaf Sarker who by registred saf kabala deed No. 13130 dated 11-7-1967 transferred 5.50 acres of land to Abdul Khalek Kha and Omar Kha, by registered deed No. 9996 dated 16-11-1967 sold 1.73 acres of land to Idris Mollah. Abdul Khalek Kha and Omar Kha by registered deed dated 16-11-1967 sold 5.50 acres of land to 18 persons. One Harunur Rashid obtained lease in respect of 2.54 acres of land in EP Case No. 50/67-68 from schedule to the suit land. Objection was raised and lease was cancelled. Thereafter, aforesaid purchaser through different deeds transferred quantum of certain land to different persons. Omar Kha and Abdul Khalek Kha, later on, by registered saf kabala deed Nos. 2311, 2312, 2313, 2544 and 2545 dated 22-1-1975 and 27-1-1975 transferred the suit land to plaintiffs. After purchase, plaintiffs mutated their names and sold some land to some other persons. Defendant No. 1-5 treat the suit property as enemy property, served notice for eviction, whereupon plaintiff filed Writ Petition No. 5509 of 2002. A Division bench of this Court on 28-8-2005 opined to file suit and this suit was filed. 

 5. It is the Case of defendant No. 1-5 that suit land recorded in CS and SA khatian in the name of Horihor who having left this country, as such, the suit land has been vested in the government as enemy property. One Harunur Rashid was given lease of certain quantum of land in EP Case No. 50/67-68. The case of plaintiffs that plaintiffs purchased the suit land from Arman Ali Sarker who is an imaginary, fictitious person and there is no exchange of the suit land with Arman Ali Sarker with recorded tenants of CS and SA khatian and deeds showing Omar Kha and Abdul Khalek Kha as vendors are all false, fabricated without any consideration. Plaintiffs filed the suit on false averments, is liable to be dismissed.
